breakthrough: A38/A39: station 09 Fish Hoek = exact coord match to the Sea Search False Bay SoundTrap-300 network (Ross-Marsh et al. 2020, Bioacoustics 10.1080/09524622.2019.1710254, UP PDF bitstream 2263/76262). Network = Smitswinkel Bay / Fish Hoek / Strandfontein / Rooi Els, moored, 14-25 m, Sept 2016 - Jan 2018. Sea Point (10) = same recorder 201650217 redeployed Oct 2018 (3 d, post-paper side deployment).
verdict_08: Station 08 = a second Sea Search False Bay site. Lead: Strandfontein (-34.088, 18.636; 183 d). Alternates: Rooi Els (-34.263, 18.847; 60 d), Smitswinkel Bay (-34.267, 18.147; 162 d). Cape-block longitude sweep (St Francis 24.95E -> 08 -> Fish Hoek 18.44E) admits Strandfontein/Rooi Els, excludes Smitswinkel; but Algoa block (03-06) proves within-block order is registry-arbitrary, so sweep is a soft prior. Simon's Town (other-AI guess) REJECTED.
verdict_11_12: West coast block between Sea Point and Saldanha. Strand/Gordon's Bay (other-AI guesses) REJECTED: east-False-Bay sites cannot sit in the 10->13 block under any ordering; and the claimed 'published coastal water quality site table' (site 8 = Simon's Town, 11 = Strand, 12 = Gordon's Bay) was NOT FOUND - the only numbered 'Site 8 = Simon's Town' table found is the whale-watch location list (O'Connor 2009: 01 Hermanus ... 08 Simon's Town), a numbering coincidence. Ranked candidates: Robben Island (Probert et al. 2025 proves ST300 + Elwen-lab field activity on/near the island, fireworks paper sites 1-4), Dassen Island (Sea Search humpback work), Langebaan (MPA + lagoon acoustics history), Yzerfontein, Table Bay/Milnerton.
